name: Frontend Web App
description: React Router and Chakra UI web application (apps/frontend) with domain-sliced queries, hooks and components, plus the shared @packmind/frontend UI helpers it consumes.

name: Backend API
description: NestJS HTTP API (apps/api) exposing per-domain controllers and modules that wire the hexagonal domain packages, with OpenTelemetry/Sentry instrumentation and startup bootstrapping.

name: Packmind CLI
description: packmind-cli (apps/cli) built hexagonally with commands, use cases and repositories for installing playbooks, linting code and syncing artifacts from a developer's repository.

name: Playbook Domain Packages
description: Hexagonal domain packages for accounts, spaces, standards, commands, skills and playbook change application that model and version a team's engineering playbook.

name: Deployment & Agent Rendering
description: Packages that turn playbook versions into agent-specific instruction files (coding-agent renderers for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, AGENTS.md) and distribute them to repositories through deployments and git provider integrations.

name: Linter Engine
description: AST parsing and rule execution packages (linter-ast, linter-execution) that detect standard violations in source code across languages.

name: Shared Infrastructure Packages
description: Cross-cutting packages reused by apps and domains: node-utils (configuration, TypeORM, BullMQ, caching), LLM provider adapters, logger, feature flags and static assets.

name: Build & Developer Tooling
description: Monorepo-wide Nx, TypeScript, pnpm, Jest and ESLint configuration, custom ESLint rules, git hooks and maintenance scripts.

name: Deployment & CI/CD
description: Docker images, Docker Compose stacks (local, production), nginx and OpenTelemetry/Grafana setup, and GitHub Actions/GitLab pipelines for build, quality, release and deployment.

name: Documentation & Agent Guidelines
description: Project docs, changelogs, contribution guides, issue templates, package READMEs and Packmind standards/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction files for coding agents.
